row.name: message_contacts_email_key
row.where: status = 'active' and email is not null

row.name: message_contacts_user_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and user_id is not null

row.name: message_contacts_phone_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and phone_normalized is not null

row.name: message_threads_mailbox_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and mailbox is not null

row.name: message_threads_student_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and student_user_id is not null

row.name: site_enquiries_phone_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and phone_normalized is not null

row.name: thread_members_contact_key
row.where: status = 'active' and left_at is null and contact_id is not null

row.name: thread_members_contact_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and contact_id is not null

row.name: message_contacts_email_check
row.value: email is null or (char_length(email) between 3 and 254 and email = lower(email) and strpos(email, '@') > 1)

row.name: message_contacts_reach_check
row.value: status = 'tobedeleted' or email is not null or phone is not null

row.name: messages_author_check
row.value:
num_nonnulls(author_user_id, author_contact_id) = case when kind = 'message' then 1 else num_nonnulls(author_user_id) end
        and (kind not in ('note', 'call', 'meeting', 'email') or author_user_id is not null)

row.name: messages_redacted_check
row.value: redacted_at is null or (body = '' and details = '{}')

row.name: thread_members_member_check
row.value: user_id is not null or contact_id is not null

row.name: thread_members_reply_key_check
row.value: reply_key is null or (contact_id is not null and octet_length(reply_key) = 32)

row.name: p_erase_update
row.using:
app.erasure_approved(tenant_id, "author_user_id") or app.erasure_approved(tenant_id, "author_contact_id")
        or app.erasure_listed(tenant_id, 'message_thread', "thread_id")
        or exists (select 1 from core.message_contacts c where c.tenant_id = messages.tenant_id
          and c.id = messages.author_contact_id and app.erasure_approved(c.tenant_id, c.user_id))

set.value: (kind = 'family' and student_user_id is not null) or (kind = 'mailbox') or (student_user_id is null)
char_length(body) <= 5000 and (redacted_at is not null or kind in ('event', 'call', 'meeting', 'email') or char_length(body) >= 1)

set.withCheck:
status = 'active' and source = 'website' and state = 'open'
        and closed_reason is null and assignee_user_id is null and first_responded_at is null
        and created_by_user_id is null and family_user_id is null and applicant_user_id is null
        and thread_id is null and handled_at is null
